inverse:
name: Deploy Tennis Note development sites

on:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cloudflare-pages-development
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    env:
      TENNISNOTE_ENVIRONMENT: development
      TENNISNOTE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED: "false"
      TENNISNOTE_DEVELOPMENT_EMAIL_SIGNIN_ENABLED: "true"
      TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DEV_TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL }}
      TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
      TENNISNOTE_PAYMENT_MODE: disabled
      TENNISNOTE_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_METHODS: ""
      TENNISNOTE_BANK_TRANSFER_ENABLED: "false"
      TENNISNOTE_SINGLE_SHEET_IMPORT_MODE: apply
      TENNISNOTE_SINGLE_SHEET_IMPORT_REVERSE_ENABLED: "true"
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
      EXPECTED_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT: ${{ vars.DEV_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_FINGERPRINT }}
      TENNISNOTE_CALLER_WORKFLOW_REF: ${{ github.workflow_ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Verify existing development account, projects, source and rollback
        run: python scripts/check_tennisnote_development_deploy_scope.py

      - name: Build isolated development sites
        run: |
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target member --output dist/member-dev
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target admin --output dist/admin-dev

      - name: Verify development deployment configuration
        run: |
          grep -q '"environment": "development"' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"enabled": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"developmentEmailSignIn": true' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"emailPasswordAuthUi": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportMode": "apply"' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportReverseEnabled": true' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/member-dev/index.html
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/admin-dev/index.html

      - name: Deploy member development PWA
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages deploy dist/member-dev --project-name=tennisnote-app-dev --branch=dev

      - name: Deploy administrator development web
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages deploy dist/admin-dev --project-name=tennisnote-admin-dev --branch=dev
name: Deploy Tennis Note development sites

on:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cloudflare-pages-development
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-and-deploy-development:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: development
    env:
      TENNISNOTE_ENVIRONMENT: development
      TENNISNOTE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED: "false"
      TENNISNOTE_DEVELOPMENT_EMAIL_SIGNIN_ENABLED: "true"
      TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL: ${{ secrets.DEV_TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_URL }}
      TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEV_TENNISNOTE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY }}
      TENNISNOTE_PAYMENT_MODE: disabled
      TENNISNOTE_ALLOWED_PAYMENT_METHODS: ""
      TENNISNOTE_BANK_TRANSFER_ENABLED: "false"
      TENNISNOTE_SINGLE_SHEET_IMPORT_MODE: apply
      TENNISNOTE_SINGLE_SHEET_IMPORT_REVERSE_ENABLED: "true"
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Build isolated development sites
        run: |
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target member --output dist/member-dev
          python scripts/build_cloudflare_pages.py --target admin --output dist/admin-dev

      - name: Verify development deployment configuration
        run: |
          grep -q '"environment": "development"' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"enabled": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"developmentEmailSignIn": true' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"emailPasswordAuthUi": false' dist/member-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportMode": "apply"' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '"singleSheetImportReverseEnabled": true' dist/admin-dev/shared/config.local.js
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/member-dev/index.html
          grep -q '개발계 · 실제 결제·푸시 차단' dist/admin-dev/index.html

      - name: Ensure Cloudflare Pages development projects exist
        shell: bash
        run: |
          project_list="$(npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages project list)"
          if ! grep -q 'tennisnote-app-dev' <<<"$project_list"; then
            npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages project create tennisnote-app-dev --production-branch=dev
          fi
          if ! grep -q 'tennisnote-admin-dev' <<<"$project_list"; then
            npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages project create tennisnote-admin-dev --production-branch=dev
          fi

      - name: Deploy member development PWA
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages deploy dist/member-dev --project-name=tennisnote-app-dev --branch=dev

      - name: Deploy administrator development web
        run: npx --yes wrangler@3.90.0 pages deploy dist/admin-dev --project-name=tennisnote-admin-dev --branch=dev
